aspects.name: Display Technology
aspects.desc: Primary medium for visible content on architecture or objects.

options.name: LED Panels
options.desc: Emissive pixel-level control for bright, high-contrast walls or sculptures.

options.name: Projection
options.desc: Projectors mapping imagery onto surfaces; supports curved geometry; requires edge blending.

options.name: LCD Video Walls
options.desc: Modular LCD screens forming a mosaic; good daytime visibility; modularity comes at cost of brightness.

options.name: OLED Panels
options.desc: Self-emissive panels with deep blacks; high contrast; higher cost and thermal considerations.

options.name: E-Paper / Reflective Displays
options.desc: Low-power, daylight-visible surfaces; limited motion/content rate.

options.name: Transparent Displays
options.desc: Displays embedded in glass or transparent substrates; content visible through glass.

options.name: Fabric Projection / Screens
options.desc: Projection onto flexible or fabric surfaces for adaptable shapes.

aspects.name: Structural Form
aspects.desc: Physical embodiment and articulation within urban fabric.

options.name: Fixed Façade
options.desc: Rigid integration with building envelope or monument.

options.name: Kinetic / Actuated
options.desc: Movable/morphing surfaces via mechanical or pneumatic actuation.

options.name: Modular / Portable
options.desc: Disassemblable pods or cubes for temporary deployments.

options.name: Fabric / Membrane
options.desc: Soft geometry with projection; light-weight and transportable.

options.name: Glass Brick / Integrated Panels
options.desc: Cavity with embedded screens or lighting within brick-like modules.

options.name: Sculptural Light Monument
options.desc: Standalone form with light-emitting surface elements.

aspects.name: Illumination Approach
aspects.desc: How light is produced or manipulated to create imagery.

options.name: Emissive LEDs
options.desc: Direct light sources emitting content on surfaces.

options.name: Projection-based Illumination
options.desc: External light projecting imagery onto surfaces.

options.name: Reflective/Transmissive Lighting
options.desc: Diffusion and reflection via materials and geometry.

options.name: Bioluminescent-like Diffusion
options.desc: Soft, diffuse lighting using diffusion layers and polymers.

options.name: Solar-powered Ambient Lighting
options.desc: Lighting powered by solar with energy storage for sustainability.

options.name: Hybrid Lighting
options.desc: Combination of LEDs and projection for layered, multi-sensor effects.

aspects.name: Content Model
aspects.desc: Nature of content and data driving the work.

options.name: Pre-rendered Sequences
options.desc: Scripted animations and footage baked offline.

options.name: Real-time Generative Content
options.desc: Algorithmically generated visuals responding to inputs.

options.name: Data-driven Visualizations
options.desc: Live or historical data informing visuals.

options.name: Participatory Content
options.desc: Audience contributions shape content in real time.

options.name: Archive / Documentary
options.desc: Historical material reinterpreted for present contexts.

options.name: Narrative / Poetic
options.desc: Story-driven visuals with symbolic/personal meaning.

aspects.name: Pixel Strategy
aspects.desc: Approach to resolution, density, and control granularity.

options.name: Pixel-level Control
options.desc: Every pixel is addressable for full-detail imagery.

options.name: Zone-based Control
options.desc: Regions or tiles controlled as groups for efficiency.

options.name: Global Color/Brightness Only
options.desc: Uniform changes across entire surface; low data load.

options.name: Hybrid Density
options.desc: High density in key areas; lower density elsewhere.

options.name: Multi-layer Overlays
options.desc: Depth or parallax with layered content.

options.name: Content-driven Density
options.desc: Pixel density adapts to narrative importance or viewer distance.

aspects.name: Transmission / Pipeline
aspects.desc: How content is authored, transmitted, and synchronized.

options.name: Local CMS / Edge Processing
options.desc: On-site processing with edge blending and calibration.

options.name: Central Streaming
options.desc: Remote delivery to onsite players; low-latency routing considered.

options.name: Wireless / Networked
options.desc: Content delivered over Wi‑Fi/5G; bandwidth and latency managed.

options.name: Hybrid On-site + Remote
options.desc: Mix of local generation with remote updates and control.

options.name: Edge Calibration & Synchronization
options.desc: Dedicated routines for cross-device alignment and timing.

aspects.name: Site Context
aspects.desc: Environment and typology where the work engages.

options.name: Urban Square / Park
options.desc: Public space with high visibility and pedestrian flow.

options.name: Building Façade
options.desc: Architectural envelope as primary canvas.

options.name: Transit Hub / Underpass
options.desc: High-throughput space with safety and wayfinding considerations.

options.name: Indoor / Atrium
options.desc: Controlled lighting, acoustics, and access.

options.name: Rural / Peripheral
options.desc: Long sightlines, limited ambient light, remote viewers.

options.name: Industrial / Institutional
options.desc: Robust hardware requirements and service access.

aspects.name: Interaction / Audience
aspects.desc: Level and type of audience interaction.

options.name: Passive Viewing
options.desc: Content designed for observation without interaction.

options.name: Sensors / Gesture
options.desc: Motion, proximity, audio or touch inputs influence visuals.

options.name: Participatory Content
options.desc: Audience contributes content or narrative decisions.

options.name: Crowd-driven Content
options.desc: Content evolves via collective inputs or environmental data.

options.name: Grid-powered
options.desc: Standard electrical supply with backups.

options.name: Solar-powered
options.desc: On-site photovoltaic with storage; daylight-optimized.

options.name: Battery-backed
options.desc: Uninterruptible power with contained energy storage.

options.name: Hybrid
options.desc: Multiple sources for reliability and continuity.

aspects.name: Narrative / Content Governance
aspects.desc: Editorial stance and how content is curated.

options.name: Monumental Memory
options.desc: Portraits/portraits of individuals or historic events.

options.name: Data-storytelling
options.desc: Quantitative/systemic narratives informed by data.

options.name: Activist / Political
options.desc: Content engages with social issues and public discourse.

options.name: Cultural Heritage
options.desc: Indigenous knowledge or local histories represented.

aspects.name: Environmental & Safety
aspects.desc: Considerations for daylight, glare, and safety.

options.name: Daylight Readability
options.desc: Content remains legible under bright conditions.

options.name: Glare Minimization
options.desc: Design to reduce glare and stray light.

options.name: Privacy-preserving
options.desc: Avoid capturing or exposing personal data.

options.name: Weatherproofing
options.desc: Outdoor-ready with appropriate IP rating and seals.

options.name: Modular / Replaceable
options.desc: Easily swapped components for upgrades or repair.

options.name: Remote Diagnostics
options.desc: Self-diagnostic systems with remote alerts.

options.name: Low-maintenance Materials
options.desc: Durable, weather-resistant components and finishes.
